items.title: How AI Is Forcing China to Reshape Industrial Policy
items.content: Kyle Chan on Beijing's plan to become technologically self-reliant.
items.contentSnippet: Kyle Chan on Beijing's plan to become technologically self-reliant.
items.creator: Joe Weisenthal and Tracy Alloway

summaries.zh: 人工智能推动中国调整产业政策，旨在实现技术自主。北京计划通过政策重塑，增强本土科技能力，应对AI发展带来的挑战。此举旨在确保国家在关键技术领域的独立性，适应全球科技竞争格局。
summaries.en: AI is driving China to reshape its industrial policy, aiming for technological self-reliance. The shift reflects Beijing's strategy to reduce dependence on foreign technology and strengthen domestic innovation. This move aligns with China's broader goals of economic autonomy and leadership in advanced industries. The policy changes are expected to influence investment, research, and development priorities across key sectors.

items.title: Europe’s Power Market Is Flashing a Warning to Its Economy
items.content: At a factory in Germany, there are increasingly hours when it is simply too expensive to produce steel.
items.contentSnippet: At a factory in Germany, there are increasingly hours when it is simply too expensive to produce steel.
items.creator: Eva Brendel

summaries.zh: 欧洲电力市场正向其经济发出警告。在德国的一家工厂，由于电力成本不断攀升，越来越多的时间变得无法进行钢铁生产。这一现象凸显了能源危机对制造业的影响，可能引发经济压力。
summaries.en: The article highlights rising energy costs in Europe, particularly in Germany, making steel production unaffordable during certain hours. This situation reflects broader challenges in Europe's power market, signaling potential economic strain due to high energy prices. The issue underscores the vulnerability of industries to volatile energy costs, impacting production and economic stability.

summaries.zh:
文章标题：《奇货：人工智能如何重塑中国产业政策》（播客）

文章内容摘要：本期播客探讨了如何借助中国科技公司实现技术自给自足，同时保持在人工智能军备竞赛中的竞争力。作者Kyle Chan分析了北京对全球人工智能浪潮的应对策略，以及中国企业商业目标与政府长期规划之间的矛盾。他解释了企业如何利用共享的专业知识和供应链发展，但未详细说明具体案例。
summaries.en: The podcast "Odd Lots" explores how AI is reshaping China's industrial policy. Kyle Chan, a Brookings Institution fellow, discusses China's efforts to achieve technological self-reliance while competing in the AI arms race. He examines tensions between commercial goals of tech companies and the government's long-term plans, highlighting how firms leverage shared expertise and supply chains to advance. The conversation addresses Beijing's response to the global AI boom.

items.title: Billionaire Raises $720 Million Private Credit for Megha Buyout
items.content: Indian billionaire P.V. Krishna Reddy has secured about 67 billion rupees ($720 million) from global private credit investors to buy out his uncle’s stake in Megha Engineering & Infrastructures Ltd., according to people familiar with the matter, in a layered transaction that is one of the country’s biggest deals this year.

items.creator: Dipika Lalwani

summaries.zh: 印度亿万富翁P.V.克里希纳雷迪已从全球私人信贷投资者那里筹集约670亿卢比（720亿美元），用于收购其叔叔在Megha Engineering & Infrastructures Ltd.的股份。这笔分层交易是今年印度规模最大的交易之一。
summaries.en: Indian billionaire P.V. Krishna Reddy raised $720 million in private credit to acquire his uncle's stake in Megha Engineering & Infrastructures Ltd. The deal, part of a layered transaction, is one of India's largest this year, sources confirmed.

items.title: China Offshore Tax Clampdown Pushes Budget Into Rare Surplus
items.content: China’s budget swung into a rare surplus in October, as tighter scrutiny of offshore wealth produced a one-off bonanza of individual income tax receipts and offset a long-awaited increase in fiscal spending.

summaries.en: China's budget entered a rare surplus in October due to increased individual income tax revenue from stricter oversight of offshore wealth. This one-time gain offset the impact of higher fiscal spending, marking an unusual financial outcome.

items.title: J&J Snack Foods CEO on 4Q Results and Consumer Sentiment
items.content: J&J Snack Foods CEO Dan Fachner said the company’s turnaround is on track after a strong year, citing Project Apollo’s more than $25 million in durable savings. A second phase, Apollo 2, is expected to generate another $5 million by 2027 through distribution and manufacturing improvements. Fachner speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Adjusting for Credit Risk: Masters In Business with David Eichhorn
items.content: Barry speaks with David Eichhorn, CEO and Head of Investment Strategies at NISA Investment Advisors. They discuss his early days as a quant at JPMorgan before returning home to St. Louis to work at NISA. They also discuss the risks and benefits of the private credit market, along with the dangers of private credit going into pension funds and 401Ks. They also discuss liability investment strategies for managing over $483 billion in client assets.  (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Fear and ‘Hot Sauce’: Young Investors Want To Catch Up
items.content: Buzzy stocks, leveraged ETFs, and a generation feeling left behind. BlackRock’s Gargi Chaudhuri discusses ways investors can dabble in risky products while also leaning into time-proven strategies. 文章内容：黑石集团高迪·乔杜里在“彭博财富”节目中，与主持人汤姆·基恩和斯卡雷特·傅讨论了年轻投资者如何涉足高风险产品，同时坚持传统策略。傅还赞扬了埃里克·巴尔丘纳斯对“辣酱”投资产品的报道。

items.title: Fiber Network Operator Zayo Delays Public ABS Sale Until 2027
items.content: Fiber-optic network operator Zayo Group Holdings Inc. is delaying the public-market leg of a planned asset-backed securities offering, while moving ahead with the privately placed portion, according to people with knowledge of the matter.
items.contentSnippet: Fiber-optic network operator Zayo Group Holdings Inc. is delaying the public-market leg of a planned asset-backed securities offering, while moving ahead with the privately placed portion, according to people with knowledge of the matter.
items.creator: Menghan Xiao and Reshmi Basu

summaries.zh: 光纤网络运营商Zayo集团推迟了原定资产支持证券发行的公募部分，但将私募部分继续推进。知情人士透露，此举是为了调整市场策略。
summaries.en: Zayo Group Holdings Inc., a fiber-optic network operator, is postponing the public offering of its asset-backed securities (ABS) until 2027. The company is proceeding with the private placement portion of the offering, sources confirmed. The delay affects the public market segment while the private placement remains on track.

items.title: CrowdStrike Said in Talks to Buy Cybersecurity Firm Zscaler
items.content: CrowdStrike Holdings Inc. is in talks to acquire Zscaler Inc., according to people familiar with the matter, in a deal that would be among the largest-ever in the cybersecurity sector. Zscaler, which had a market value of $32 billion at the end of regular trading Friday, rose about 16% after the close. The two companies are discussing a potential combination that could come together soon, the people said, asking not to be identified because the information is confidential. Bloomberg News Deals Reporter Ryan Gould reports on the deal.  (Source: Bloomberg)
